description: A card that is one link: an illustration in a Media slot, a headline, and a chevron. The whole surface is the target and the headline is the accessible name. Used in the Acrobat "Get started with Acrobat tools" row (ActionCardRow).

usages: 14278:197804 (xl - 2560px page › Quick Actions › 6-Up 13713:193638: ActionCardRow instance replacing the hand-drawn Row)
14226:196800 (Row (golden): the original hand-drawn tiles, kept for the visual eval)
figma.notes: Single COMPONENT (no variants yet): VERTICAL auto layout, hug height, media top and copy pinned to the bottom; padding spacing/xl, gap spacing/md, fill background/subtle, radius border/radius/md. Illustrations are content: image fills on the Media instance, exported to apps/storybook/stories/assets/action-card/.

props.name: target
props.notes: Integration detail; new-window links append an accessible hint.

props.name: mediaSrc

figma.notes: Media instance, Aspect Ratio=4:3, Radii=none, Type=image; the illustration is the instance's image fill.

props.notes: Decorative illustration; aria-hidden. Assets: apps/storybook/stories/assets/action-card/<slug>_2x.png (+ .svg for vector art).

props.name: headline
props.notes: The card's accessible name (whole card is the link). Default in Figma: "Headline".

root.notes: Block-level link, 313px wide in the row. No padding on the root: the media is full-bleed (top, clipped by the card's radius) and the copy block carries its own padding. Hug height; in a row the cards stretch to the tallest. radius/lg (22px) and spacing/2xl (40px) are the tokens nearest the original 26px / 39px.

slot.name: Media
slot.notes: Media 4:3 instance (closest ratio the Media set offers to the original 313×214 art area); its placeholder Overlay is hidden.

media.notes: Full-bleed, top of the card, 4:3 (313×235). The illustration is content: an image fill on the Media instance, exported from the original tile cropped at the copy block's top (313×228).

copy.notes: Headline and chevron on one row, start-aligned, vertically centred; the chevron hugs the text (the headline hugs its content up to the row's inner width).

headline.notes: Text style s2a/typography/heading-5 (24px): the rung nearest the original 29px that keeps most headlines on one line; two-line headlines make the card 339 tall.

chevron.notes: S2a_Icon_Chevron_Right at 16px; decorative, never the only indication of the link (WCAG 1.4.1).

keyboard.action: moves focus to the card as one stop

notes: One link, one accessible name: the headline text. Media, icon and chevron are aria-hidden so the name is not padded with noise.
No interactive element may be nested inside the card (a link inside a link is invalid HTML and unreachable by keyboard).
Focus ring is drawn on the whole card surface (2.4.7) and the target is at least 24×24 (2.5.8).
Headline and description meet 4.5:1 on the card surface; the chevron and any border meet 3:1 (1.4.3, 1.4.11).
The arrow is decorative: link purpose comes from the headline text (2.4.4), not from the glyph alone (1.4.1).

decisions.question: Scaffolded as link-card (roles include heading and cta with no repeated unit). Confirm, or re-run npm run specs:scaffold -- --slug=action-card --archetype=<link-card|card|collection>.
decisions.evidence: roles heading, cta, media, divider; pattern frame, 0 repeats

decisions.question: Levers were derived from roles (media → mediaSrc, heading → headline, divider → divider, cta → ctaLabel), not from component properties. Confirm names and which are authored (lever true) versus integration (lever false).
decisions.decision: Two levers: headline (TEXT property Headline) and mediaSrc (INSTANCE_SWAP property Media). No CTA label: the chevron is the affordance and the headline carries the name.

decisions.question: 11 painted layers carry no variable (/ fills, /Group 2087327847/Abc fills, /Line 87474 strokes, /Group 2085666331/Rectangle 2147231707 strokes, /Group 2085666331/Ellipse 36325 fills+strokes, /Group 2085666331/Ellipse 36326 fills+strokes, …). Bind them to S2A tokens in Figma, or record a raw: exception with the reason.
decisions.decision: The tile was rebuilt as a token-bound component; the only unbound paint left is the image fill on the Media instance's Asset layer, which is content by design.

decisions.question: 11 layers carry Figma-generated names (/Copy >/Chevron/Vector, /Group 2087327847, /Line 87474, /Group 2085666331, /Group 2085666331/Rectangle 2147231707, …). Build set from this contract produces the normalized set (.root, .part names); replace the frame with it once reviewed.
decisions.decision: Rebuilt: .root / .media / .copy / .headline / .chevron. Illustrations exported once and placed as image fills; six instances replace the six hand-drawn frames.

decisions.question: Additional shape layers outside the media group (/Group 2085666331). Fold them into the Media instance or name them as parts.
decisions.decision: Art layers are no longer part of the component; each illustration is an exported asset (PNG@2x + SVG where vector).

decisions.question: Structural match says extend-or-new: closest existing contract is ProductCard (score 0.74). Extend it instead of adding a component?
decisions.evidence: ProductCard (0.74) is closest; extend it with divider, text or start a new contract.

decisions.question: No code exists yet. Generate packages/components/src/action-card/action-card.js from the spec (/spec-to-html), run npm run evidence:code -- --slug=action-card, then remove anchors.code.pending.

The original headline is 29px, between heading-5 (24) and heading-4 (36). heading-5 keeps one-line headlines like the golden; heading-4 reads closer in weight but wraps four of six. Which rung is the tile's?
decisions.decision: heading-5 for now (closest rung, one-line headlines). Revisit if the row needs more presence.
